requirements.text: The app must have a modern and fast design with a sleek interface and simple navigation.
The app must provide real-time push notifications for every transaction, including details such as the amount, the recipient, and the remaining balance.
The app must include a button for instantly freezing the card, with a confirmation notification to inform the user that the action was successful.
The app must include a button to easily unfreeze the card.
The app must provide budgeting tools that allow users to set monthly limits for different categories such as groceries, dining, and transport.
The app must send alerts when users are approaching or exceeding their monthly budget limits.
